groups.name: sugar_grns
groups.evidence: Labellar sweet/sugar-sensing GRNs, left hemisphere. IDs are exactly those activated computationally in Shiu et al. 2024 (Nature 634:210-219) Fig 1c/d and listed as sugar_l_0..20 in Supplementary Table 1A (and ST4) of the paper (41586_2024_7763_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx, downloaded from https://media.springernature.com/original/springer-static/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fs41586-024-07763-9/MediaObjects/41586_2024_7763_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx). Engert et al. 2022 (eLife 11:e78110, PMC9170244) identified these as connectivity clusters 4/5 best-matching Gr64f sugar-GRN projections. Cross-check vs Schlegel et al. 2024 annotations: 20/21 present in current table, all cell_type LB3, cell_sub_class sugar/water, side left, top_nt acetylcholine. sugar_l_13 (Shiu ID 720575940620900446) is a superseded FlyWire root ID absent from the current table; updated ID unresolved (candidate set = 27 unmatched left LB3 cells; needs verification).

groups.name: bitter_grns
groups.evidence: Labellar bitter-sensing (Gr66a) GRNs, left hemisphere. IDs are exactly those activated in Shiu et al. 2024 Fig 3b/d (bitter_l_0..20 in Supplementary Table 4). Engert et al. 2022 identified the corresponding clusters (groups 1 and 2) as best-matching Gr66a bitter-GRN projections. Cross-check vs Schlegel annotations: 20/21 present, all cell_sub_class bitter, cell_types LB1a-d, side left. NOTE: Eckstein NT predictions give several of these as serotonin (not acetylcholine) - flag for model NT choice. bitter_l_15 (Shiu ID 720575940618600651) is a superseded root ID absent from the current table; best candidate by elimination is 720575940619072513 (the only unclaimed left LB1c) - needs verification.

groups.name: water_grns
groups.evidence: Labellar water-sensing (ppk28) GRNs, left hemisphere. IDs are exactly those activated in Shiu et al. 2024 (water_l_0..17 in Supplementary Tables 4/5/6A). Engert et al. 2022 identified this cluster (group 6) as best-matching ppk28 water-GRN projections. Cross-check vs Schlegel annotations: 18/18 present in current table; 17 are cell_type LB3 and 1 (water_l_15 = 720575940634796536) is LB2d; all cell_sub_class sugar/water, side left, top_nt acetylcholine. Shui et al. showed sugar and water GRNs converge on largely shared downstream networks (their Fig 4) - both groups are needed to reproduce the sugar/water co-activation experiments.

groups.name: lowsalt_grns
groups.evidence: Labellar Ir94e GRNs (4th taste category in Shiu et al. 2024; respond to low salt, Jaeger et al. 2018; Engert et al. 2022 cluster 3 best-matched Ir94e projections). IDs are exactly those activated in Shiu et al. 2024 Fig 3c/e (Ir94e_l_0..17 in Supplementary Table 4). Cross-check vs Schlegel annotations: 18/18 present, split across TWO Schlegel sub-classes - 11 cells typed LB1e under cell_sub_class "bitter" and 7 cells (LB2a-b x4, LB2c x3) under cell_sub_class "low-salt". I.e. Schlegel "low-salt" != Ir94e exactly: 2 left LB4a cells (720575940632293346, 720575940620856046) are in the Schlegel low-salt subclass but NOT in Shiu Ir94e set, while all 11 LB1e "bitter"-subclass cells ARE Ir94e. Use this exact 18-cell list (not the Schlegel subclass) to reproduce the Shiu Ir94e experiments.

groups.name: proboscis_mns
groups.evidence: Proboscis motor neurons responding to sugar GRN activation in Shiu et al. 2024 (their Fig 1c/d: MN6, MN8, MN9, MN11; exact FlyWire IDs from Supplementary Tables 1A/1B/1C/6B). MN9 mapping: MN9_r = 720575940660219265 = Schlegel cell_type CB0701 right (EXACT ID match in Shiu ST1B row 40, ST1C, ST6B; fires strongly with contralateral left-sugar-GRN activation, the key sensorimotor validation experiment). MN9_l = 720575940618238523 = CB0701 left, the PUTATIVE current ID for Shiu MN9_l 720575940645521262, which is a superseded root ID absent from the current table; evidence: CB0701 is a bilateral pair, the right member matches MN9_r exactly, and the left member is the only remaining CB0701 (soma x=115232 mirrors MN9_r x=145856 about the brain midline ~131004, |offsets| 15772 vs 14852 nm). McKellar et al. 2020 (eLife 9:e54978, PMC7316511) define mn9 as the motor neuron of muscle 9 (lateral pharyngeal muscle, rostrum protractor/fulcrum protractor; split-GAL4s VT061715/VT005008; bilateral pair; activation lifts/protracts the rostrum, silencing blocks rostrum+haustellum extension during feeding) - i.e. the "rostrum-lifting MN" of the Shiu validation. Other members: MN6 = CB0858 l/r (EXACT), MN8 = CB0911 l/r (EXACT), MN11 = CB0700 l/r (EXACT per Shiu ST1A) + CB0915 r (EXACT) + CB0915 l 720575940618539810 (candidate update for Shiu 4th MN11 ID 720575940619048827, superseded/absent; McKellar mn11 has dorsal and ventral divisions mn11D/mn11V, consistent with 2 bilateral pairs = 4 MN11 neurons).
